changelog:
- Initial release of kuaishou-scraper-api skill.
- Enables access to Kuaishou (China) profiles, posts, live status, videos, comment threads, hashtag feeds, leaderboards, and four search types as structured JSON.
- Provides 14 endpoints with tiered pricing (1, 2, 10, or 40 credits per endpoint).
- Supports cursor-based pagination for lists and searches.
- Requires SCAVIO_API_KEY for authentication.
display_name: Kuaishou Scraper API - Profiles, Videos, Comments, Search
summary: Read Kuaishou (China) profiles, posts, live status, videos, comment threads, hashtag feeds, leaderboards and four kinds of search as structured JSON. 14 endpoints priced per endpoint at 1, 2, 10 or 40 credits.
